CustomField.description: Automatically determines the shipping condition based on the selected INCO Terms 1 value
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(pkl_INCOTerms1__c), "DAP – Delivered at Place", "Standard Shipping", "CPT - Carriage Paid To", "Standard Shipping", "DDP - Delivered Duty Paid", "Standard Shipping", "FCA - Free Carrier", "Pickup", "")
CustomField.label: Shipping Condition
